currentStateNotice: Not enabled in World Model v1. See research dossier for dated research.
evidenceNotice: Evidence grades are retained from the saved review. Owner approval is not independent source authentication or a fresh source check.

items.title: OPEC and OPEC+
items.statement: OPEC membership differs from OPEC+ cooperation. Russian participation in the latter does not make Russia an OPEC member.
limitations: Participants and signatories can change. Membership alone does not establish production, compliance or price control.

items.title: Policy, capacity, inventory and delivered flow
items.statement: Quotas are policy arrangements; spare capacity is conditional capability; SPR inventory is a stock. Production, releases and deliveries are flows over a period. They are not interchangeable.
limitations: Capacity definitions require a provider and version. Announcement is not implementation; inventory does not ensure immediate withdrawal.
aliases: spare capacity is not delivered flow

items.title: SWIFT, settlement and correspondent accounts
items.statement: SWIFT supplies financial messaging, CHIPS supplies large-value dollar clearing and settlement, and correspondent accounts are ledger relationships. Messaging access is neither currency itself nor final settlement.
limitations: Disconnection can create severe friction without proving total financial isolation. Alternative messaging does not remove other legal restrictions.

items.title: Reserve shares are not capital flows
items.statement: A reserve currency share is a stock ratio within a defined scope. Changes may reflect transactions, exchange rates, valuation or methodology. COFER foreign-exchange reserves exclude gold.
limitations: Consistent quantities and valuation adjustments are needed to identify net allocation. Aggregate shares cannot establish a country’s motive or represent all official reserves.
aliases: reserve share is not capital flow
gold valuation is not gold purchase

items.title: Debt stocks and financing flows
items.statement: Deficits measure a period’s fiscal balance; debt is a stock. Gross debt, debt held by the public and marketable debt have different scopes. Public holdings include the Fed. Gross auctions, private net borrowing and deficits differ.
limitations: Match periods, cash balances, maturities and intragovernmental holdings before comparing definitions.

items.title: Fiscal dominance: an identification boundary
items.statement: Fiscal dominance requires evidence that fiscal financing constrains monetary policy or price-stability choices. High debt, one rate cut or QE alone is insufficient. Financial repression is a separate mechanism to identify.
limitations: This is a conceptual boundary, not a diagnosis of the current US regime. Academic definitions vary and their versions matter.
aliases: high debt is not fiscal dominance
QE is not sufficient regime evidence

items.title: Unhedged yen carry versus hedged investment
items.statement: Unhedged yen carry bears yen funding and foreign-asset risk. Fully hedged overseas investment and dollar-funded yen basis trades cannot automatically be classified as the same directional speculative carry.
limitations: Match funding rates, forwards, basis, maturity and fees. Institutional domicile does not identify funding currency or net exposure.
aliases: Japanese overseas investment is not all carry

items.title: Limits of yen carry proxies
items.statement: Derivative notionals, net yen futures positions and Japanese residents’ overseas securities transactions each cover only part of the market. None alone measures global net yen carry leverage or liquidation.
limitations: Useful statistics remain incomplete: hedges, bilateral relationships, classifications and non-bank coverage gaps matter.
aliases: MOF flow is not global unwind

items.title: Serial shipping routes and double counting
items.statement: The same cargo may cross several serial chokepoints, so their totals are not additive. Combined Suez and SUMED oil volume is not all canal shipping and cannot be extended to LNG or containers.
limitations: Match cargo, route, period, direction and scope. Do not choose a preferred value from the unresolved Malacca quarter.

items.title: Vessel tonnage is not cargo volume
items.statement: PC/UMS and other vessel-volume-related tonnage, cargo weight, value, transits and ton-miles measure different things. Locks, draft and reservation capacity do not measure cargo already shipped.
limitations: Some saved sources had unknown publication dates or index excerpts only. This approves measurement distinctions, not a current operating status.

items.title: Long-yield measurement framework
items.statement: Nominal long yields can be decomposed into expected short rates and a term premium. Components are model estimates; a higher nominal yield alone does not identify higher expected policy rates.
limitations: Models, tenor and sample affect estimates. No current estimate or directional rule is supplied. Detailed TIPS-spread decomposition was not promoted.

items.title: Shared evidence-time rule
items.statement: Keep policy announcement, legal effectiveness, actual transaction or observation, and evidence receipt clocks separate. Announcement does not prove application to every transaction; retrieval time is not source observation time.
limitations: Specific legal effect still requires the underlying document. Unknown clocks remain unknown; this reference does not change existing evaluators.
aliases: retrieval time is not observation time

items.title: Treasury–Fed Accord, 1951
items.statement: The 1951 Treasury–Fed Accord changed the fiscal–monetary relationship inherited from wartime Treasury rate arrangements.
limitations: A historical institutional arrangement is not the current US regime.

details.whatChanged: Institutional separation of government debt management and monetary policy.
details.whyStructurallyRelevant: A dated example for distinguishing financing constraints from policy autonomy.

items.title: BOJ framework change, 2024
items.statement: In March 2024 the BOJ exited its negative-rate and yield-curve-control framework. The prior framework does not describe every later period.
limitations: This does not provide current financing rates. Saved support includes readable dates and labels in a policy-history chart.

details.whatChanged: A change in the monetary operating framework.
details.whyStructurallyRelevant: An institutional boundary when interpreting historical yen carry samples.

items.title: Deliverable oil and macro transmission
items.statement: Deliverable supply loss may transmit through inventories, product costs and real incomes into inflation, activity and policy; intermediate steps cannot be skipped.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: Persistent loss of physical supply or delivery
details.firstOrderEffect: Inventories or substitute supply face pressure; spot and product costs may rise
secondOrderEffects: Household purchasing power and company margins change
Cost diffusion and expectations may affect policy; a rate hike is not inevitable
counterforces: Alternative supply, inventory release or route restoration
Subsidies, margin absorption and anchored expectations
observableConfirmation: Non-energy prices, wages, expectations and central-bank explanations
falsification: Deliveries recover and inventories rebuild without cost diffusion
Demand weakness explains more than the supply hypothesis
details.timeHorizon: Physical: days to months; downstream and policy: weeks to quarters, with no fixed lag
details.scopeNote: Cost constraints have stronger support than the entire conditional macro chain.

items.title: Financial access and trade costs
items.statement: Legal restrictions can change which transactions intermediaries serve. Financing costs and actual business volumes depend on enforcement, permissions and substitution.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: Applicable account or transaction restrictions change
details.firstOrderEffect: Intermediaries cannot or will not process particular transactions
secondOrderEffects: Capital or trade access costs may rise
Payment routes, net receipts or deliveries may adjust
observableConfirmation: Payment refusals, credit costs and matched trade quantities
falsification: Business volumes and costs remain unchanged
An export discount exists without evidence of a global shortage
details.timeHorizon: Days to quarters; legal effect and economic impact are separate

items.title: Fixed-rate debt rollover costs
items.statement: Contractual interest costs on existing fixed-rate debt do not all reset immediately with market yields. Higher funding costs enter interest payments through new borrowing and refinancing.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: New or rollover funding rates exceed replaced costs
details.firstOrderEffect: Costs change on maturing or newly borrowed amounts
secondOrderEffects: Cash and future financing needs may change
observableConfirmation: Maturity profile, refinancing and effective rates
Actual net interest and cash flows
falsification: Multiplying today’s ten-year yield by all debt is not valid
Maturity structure or revenues offset pressure
details.timeHorizon: Quarters to years, according to the maturity profile
details.scopeNote: Only fixed-rate contractual interest and refinancing arithmetic is well established. Bond market prices can revalue immediately. Floating and indexed terms require separate treatment; crisis, inflation and FX consequences are not facts.

items.title: Treasury duration and dollar-asset demand
items.statement: Net issuance composition and safe-asset demand jointly affect private duration absorption. Yield reactions are not a one-variable function of total debt.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: Treasury net issuance, tenor composition or investor demand changes
details.firstOrderEffect: Private duration absorption or demand for dollar safe assets changes
secondOrderEffects: Term premiums and financing conditions may change
Reserve, collateral and allocation uses interact
observableConfirmation: Net duration supply, tenor and holder composition
Multiple premium estimates and funding-market evidence
falsification: Demand expands with supply and absorption remains orderly
One weak auction is mistaken for a lasting fiscal crisis
details.timeHorizon: Days to quarters; network structure over years
details.scopeNote: The asset role is structural; marginal yield and currency effects remain conditional.

items.title: FX hedging and institutional allocation
items.statement: Cross-currency funding and overseas allocation depend on matched-tenor funding, forwards, basis and liabilities. Policy-rate differentials do not equal hedged returns.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: Matched-tenor funding spreads, FX forwards, basis or target returns change
details.firstOrderEffect: Hedge costs and portfolio net returns change
secondOrderEffects: Institutions may change hedges or allocation
Currency funding and bond demand may change
counterforces: Natural currency income and central-bank backstops
observableConfirmation: Matched funding and forward or basis data
falsification: Policy rates or resident net sales alone are used to infer carry
Hedged returns and allocations do not change
details.timeHorizon: Funding: hours to days; allocation: days to quarters

items.title: Yen losses, margin and possible unwind
items.statement: Yen appreciation can hurt unhedged short-yen portfolios. Tight funding, margin or risk constraints may amplify losses into cross-asset deleveraging; voluntary reductions are also possible.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: Unhedged yen-funded portfolios suffer currency, asset or volatility shocks
details.firstOrderEffect: Net asset value, collateral or risk-limit headroom declines
secondOrderEffects: Margin is posted or risk and positions are reduced
Selling target assets and buying back funding currency may amplify liquidity pressure
counterforces: Funding rollover, backstop liquidity and other buyers
falsification: Portfolios are hedged or funding constraints do not bind
Only price co-movement, with no position or funding evidence
An alternative such as US macro news explains more
details.timeHorizon: Hours to weeks; no guaranteed liquidation time
details.scopeNote: Loss arithmetic is distinct from forced liquidation. Historical BIS examples are not evidence of a current unwind.

items.title: Rerouting, vessel time and costs
items.statement: Rerouting can increase voyage time and fuel, absorb effective fleet capacity and affect freight and delivery. Effects require route, vessel and demand evidence.
limitations: Not a fixed direction, probability or trade trigger. Current occurrence requires independent observations.

details.trigger: An original route is constrained and vessels actually use a longer route
details.firstOrderEffect: Voyage time, fuel and fleet occupancy increase
secondOrderEffects: Delivery frequency and inventory needs change
Freight and downstream costs may change
counterforces: Weaker demand, inventories and margin absorption
falsification: Only headlines, without route or delivery changes
Port congestion or demand better explains costs
details.timeHorizon: Voyages: days to weeks; downstream: weeks to quarters
details.scopeNote: Some UNCTAD support was limited to saved index excerpts. No cost coefficient, uniform delay or inflation elasticity was recalculated.

items.title: EU legal authority and SWIFT
items.statement: SWIFT is subject to applicable EU and Belgian law. Its restrictions on designated entities must be distinguished from the role of lawmakers.
limitations: Not every sanction has the same scope; this does not say all banks are excluded or treat company action as an arbitrary instruction from any country.

details.asOfMeaning: Original research retrieval date, not a new law’s effective date. Page update time unknown.

items.title: Central-bank dollar swap backstop
items.statement: The Fed–BOJ central-bank swap relationship provides a dollar backstop. BOJ lending to local institutions is distinct from the Fed’s relationship with the central bank.
limitations: Facility authorization or existence is not an observed current draw, universal access, or direct financing of non-banks to buy equities.

details.asOfMeaning: Original FAQ retrieval date; update time unknown. Not a dated policy change.

items.title: Primary Treasury financing relation
items.statement: Treasury receives cash from issuance and repays maturing securities. Net financing differs from gross auctions, secondary turnover and changes in cash balances.
limitations: A structural relationship, not a current flow observation. Secondary purchases do not directly provide new Treasury cash.

items.title: Hypothesis: macro channels to gold
items.statement: Energy, fiscal and funding shocks may affect gold through real yields, the dollar, safe-haven preferences or cash needs. This supplies no fixed GLD direction.
limitations: External sources support intermediate channels, not a verified GLD coefficient. Central-bank physical gold purchases are not GLD creations or redemptions.

details.mechanism: Channels may oppose each other; match evidence available at the time instead of inferring prices from a headline.
counterforces: Gold and ETF-specific supply and demand
requiredObservations: Physical gold quantities and GLD flows separately
falsification: Intermediate variables do not change or gold-specific factors explain the result

items.title: Hypothesis: funding channels to risk assets
items.statement: Funding, margin and risk-budget changes may transmit to risk assets including BTC and IBIT. Direct yen-funded exposure remains unknown.
limitations: Neither carry nor shipping narratives establish BTC/IBIT funding sources. ETF and underlying-asset data remain separate.

intermediateVariables: Risk budgets and actual position reductions
details.targetAssetClass: Broad risk assets including BTC / IBIT
details.mechanism: Liquidity and leverage may transmit indirectly; no direction, probability or trade permission follows.
falsification: Funding and positions stay unchanged while assets reprice independently

items.title: Actual oil delivery
items.statement: Is deliverable physical oil falling, or are only quotas, headlines or demand changing?
limitations: One price does not identify a war’s effect
Inventory is not immediate release capacity

details.whyItMatters: Establish the physical link before extending an inflation story.
confirmingEvidence: Matched production, quota, shipment and inventory periods
Regional and product spreads plus demand
whatItCannotProve: One price does not identify a war’s effect
Inventory is not immediate release capacity
details.knownLag: Monthly and quarterly transport estimates and weekly inventories are asynchronous and revisable.
reviewTrigger: New shipment/inventory evidence or material contradictions

items.title: Reserve allocation versus valuation
items.statement: Are reserve changes caused by allocation, valuation or denominator changes?
limitations: Cannot quantify the entire dollar funding network
Cannot infer each central bank’s political intent

details.whyItMatters: Separate portfolio transactions from reporting effects.
confirmingEvidence: Consistent quantities, currency values and valuation adjustments
Method revisions and attributed reserve-manager statements
whatItCannotProve: Cannot quantify the entire dollar funding network
Cannot infer each central bank’s political intent
details.knownLag: Quarterly releases typically lag by about a quarter; currency and gold denominators differ.

items.title: Treasury financing composition
items.statement: Has Treasury net financing composition or the rollover burden materially changed?
limitations: A single auction cannot establish a fiscal crisis
Cannot automatically identify fiscal dominance

details.whyItMatters: Gross auction totals alone do not identify new financing pressure.
confirmingEvidence: Maturities, effective interest rates and net interest
whatItCannotProve: A single auction cannot establish a fiscal crisis
details.knownLag: Quarterly plans, monthly actuals and models have different lags. Forecasts are not advance actuals.

items.title: Yen carry evidence
items.statement: Is yen-funded leverage actually unwinding, or are asset prices merely moving together?
limitations: Proxies do not cover all OTC net exposure
Resident sales may reflect rebalancing or liability matching

details.whyItMatters: Identify funding and positions before attributing cross-asset losses.
whatItCannotProve: Proxies do not cover all OTC net exposure
Resident sales may reflect rebalancing or liability matching
details.knownLag: COT usually reports Tuesday positions on Friday, subject to holidays; MOF is weekly/monthly and BIS slower.
reviewTrigger: Verifiable positions after policy or FX shocks

items.title: Shipping delivery versus delay
items.statement: Is disruption changing delivered volume, or mainly delivery time and cost?
limitations: Partial returns do not establish full-route safety
Premiums do not establish net profits
Different chokepoint totals cannot be added

details.whyItMatters: Distinguish lost cargo flow from fleet occupancy and delay.
confirmingEvidence: Routes by cargo type, transits or cargo quantities and arrivals
Freight, insurance and official draft restrictions
whatItCannotProve: Partial returns do not establish full-route safety
Premiums do not establish net profits
Different chokepoint totals cannot be added
details.knownLag: Announcement and incident verification lags differ from monthly/quarterly flows; no real-time coverage is established.
reviewTrigger: Actual flows, draft or hydrology updates

items.title: Exportable spare capacity
items.statement: How much spare oil can currently be exported quickly and delivered to buyers?
limitations: Lagged quarterly estimates
No independent engineering measurements
Extraction does not refresh the underlying observation date

details.whyUnresolved: Nominal capability, facility condition and transport constraints do not form a real-time delivery measure.
whatEvidenceWouldResolve: Same-vintage engineering availability, ports/pipelines and actual shipments
A bridge between old and new capacity definitions
sourceLimitations: Extraction does not refresh the underlying observation date

items.title: Actual sanctions impact
items.statement: What are sanctions’ actual effects on trade quantities, costs and reallocation?
limitations: Legal applicability still needs expert review
Messaging volumes or reserve shares cannot substitute for actual effects

details.whyUnresolved: Execution, permissions, rerouting and incomplete records prevent attribution from legal text alone.
whatEvidenceWouldResolve: Legal permissions/enforcement and matched transaction data
Research distinguishing valuation, gross/net quantities and duplicated paths
sourceLimitations: Legal applicability still needs expert review
Messaging volumes or reserve shares cannot substitute for actual effects

items.title: Current fiscal dominance
items.statement: Does the current regime meet a defined fiscal dominance identification test?
limitations: Insufficient current identification evidence
Institutional working papers are not official policy determinations

details.whyUnresolved: Debt size and policy co-movement do not establish monetary subordination.
whatEvidenceWouldResolve: Multiple models and comparisons of constrained versus unconstrained investors
sourceLimitations: Institutional working papers are not official policy determinations

items.title: Global net yen carry exposure
items.statement: What is current global net yen carry leverage and its final asset exposure?
limitations: Historical BIS estimates are not current totals
CFTC/MOF are partial proxies; direct BTC/IBIT shares remain unknown

details.whyUnresolved: Bilateral OTC hedges, netting, final uses and non-bank balance sheets are not fully observable.
whatEvidenceWouldResolve: Positions and margin matched to funding currencies and hedges
Estimates with explicit coverage and double-counting limits
sourceLimitations: Historical BIS estimates are not current totals
CFTC/MOF are partial proxies; direct BTC/IBIT shares remain unknown

items.title: Route-specific insurance and net costs
items.statement: What are actual insurance, waiting, rerouting costs and net results on a specified shipping route?
limitations: Safety and operating announcements do not supply complete accounts
No current net profit or universal cost elasticity

details.whyUnresolved: Individual policies, refusal terms, company exposures and matched voyages are missing.
whatEvidenceWouldResolve: Dated actual policies, fees and voyages by route and vessel type
Coverage exclusions, claims and company capital usage
sourceLimitations: Safety and operating announcements do not supply complete accounts
No current net profit or universal cost elasticity

items.title: Malacca: unresolved source totals
items.statement: The saved source gives different Malacca totals for the same quarter. Neither is canonical.
limitations: Arithmetic consistency does not substitute for a publisher correction.

details.whyUnresolved: Two totals in one source and period; no publisher correction or method explanation resolves them.
details.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Publisher correction or explicit method explanation.

items.title: EIA: unbridged capacity definitions
items.statement: Old and new capacity definitions have not been bridged into a comparable series.
limitations: Different definition vintages are not simultaneous current facts. The dated C01 candidate remains excluded.

claimA.statement: Old 30/90 shorthand; complete old constraints were not reconstructed.
claimA.locator: M01 H/N: old-definition caveat; not a new full-text verification

claimB.statement: The December 19, 2025 EIA definition changes response periods; see the deferred C01 research candidate.
claimB.locator: M01 H and source map M/S03

details.whyUnresolved: Full old/new methodology and comparable series are missing. Do not silently rewrite historical definitions.
details.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Complete old/new methods and comparable series.

edges.statement: Routes and limited bypasses constrain deliverable energy; this is a logistics dependency, not a fixed price direction.
edges.timeHorizon: Hours to months; new facilities take longer
counterforces: Inventories and alternative routes or origins
The constraint may not affect the cargo in question
limitations: A bounded cross-theme relationship, not a current event or trading direction.

edges.statement: Legal and intermediary access can change energy trading and payment costs; total embargo or inevitable lost supply does not follow.
limitations: A bounded cross-theme relationship, not a current event or trading direction.

edges.statement: Treasury securities have roles in dollar reserves and collateral. Marginal price responses remain conditional.
limitations: A bounded cross-theme relationship, not a current event or trading direction.

edges.statement: FX swaps and central-bank dollar backstops connect cross-currency financing. Hedging needs and speculative carry must be distinguished.
limitations: A bounded cross-theme relationship, not a current event or trading direction.

edges.statement: Treasury yields and matched-tenor hedge costs may change Japanese institutions’ allocations; there is no single policy-rate-differential formula.
limitations: A bounded cross-theme relationship, not a current event or trading direction.
